id: title:MattBro:link verified sso identities to existing accounts

review.posthog_relevance: These hunks implement a guard against stale user mappings and enforce account eligibility checks during SSO account linking, potentially preventing linking to deleted accounts or ineligible users.
review.reason: This chunk contains implementation changes, not just documentation. P1.F4.H3 adds a database existence check to prevent using a stale cached user ID. P1.F4.H4 and P1.F4.H5 modify the account retrieval and assignment logic, adding row-level locking and dedicated email lookup handlers. This represents a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The exact behavior change and its impact on production stability depend on the broader context of the account linking flow, which is not fully supplied. No tests or release notes are provided to independently verify the benefit or absence of regressions.

observations.limitations: This chunk is dominated by documentation and test changes. No implementation changes are supplied, so tier and score cannot be assigned. No score.

observations.behavior: Adds a guard that clears mapped_user_pk if the database row does not exist, preventing use of a stale mapping.
observations.code_quote: if mapped_user_pk is not None and not User.objects.filter(pk=mapped_user_pk).exists():
observations.posthog_connection: Checks whether a cached user mapping still corresponds to an existing User row before proceeding; this could prevent linking to a deleted account.

observations.behavior: Changes the retrieval of the installation and the lookup of an existing user; also adds transaction.atomic and a helper to get SSO block reason.
observations.posthog_connection: Uses row-level locking and a dedicated helper to check SSO block reasons, potentially changing behavior when a user is no longer eligible for SSO or has lost access.

observations.behavior: Replaces direct User.objects.filter with EmailLookupHandler and adds checks for SSO block reasons and account membership, including account creation and membership assignment.
observations.posthog_connection: Uses a dedicated email lookup handler and checks account status and SSO enforcement before creating or assigning an account, potentially changing account creation and membership assignment behavior.
